title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments

key_results: PhAI-IDE models (72B, 9B, 4B) show gains in scientific-code repair and transfer to general-purpose code, reasoning, and knowledge benchmarks

model_io.model: PhAI-IDE (72B, 9B, 4B) transformers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scientific code experience transfers positively to broader capabilities
hypotheses.result: Verified through gains on general-purpose benchmarks in code, reasoning, and knowledge

title: LimiX-2: A Contextual Mechanism Network Towards General Structured-Data Intelligence
task: General structured-data intelligence via contextual mechanism networks
key_results: LimiX-2 outperforms dataset-specific models and tabular foundation models on TabArena, TALENT, and BCCO; encodes direct causal relationships in feature attention
comments: The shift from target-centric to mechanism-oriented modeling is conceptually interesting, though evaluation remains on synthetic and tabular domains.

title: Rethinking Critic Learning in PPO: Understanding and Mitigating Value Flattening
task: Mitigate value flattening in PPO critic learning for LLM alignment
key_results: SP^3O with only 3 supervised states per response mitigates value flattening and improves policy across model sizes on Qwen3-Base
comments: Identifies a concrete failure mode in standard PPO; the sparse supervision approach is simple but the improvements are incremental.

model_io.model: PPO with critic (Qwen3-Base)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Value flattening stems from implicit variance penalty and redundant temporally-correlated updates

title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents
task: Estimate model confidence from accumulated experience rather than current inference alone
key_results: XConf beats 10-sample self-consistency on 23/24 benchmarks with lower calibration error at 1/10 the cost; selective prediction on 10% least-confident raises success by up to 8.7 points
comments: Novel paradigm leveraging historical grading; practical and broadly applicable, though depends on sufficient experience accumulation.

model_io.model: XConf (Experiential Confidence)
inputs: past graded episodes (task, reflection, confidence, outcome, lesson)
outputs: historical success rate from retrieved episodes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Confidence from accumulated experience outperforms introspection-only methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across nine benchmarks and four models; significantly lower ECE and comparable or better AUROC

title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
